2609.25272.title: MedGate-Fusion: Integrating First-Encounter Semantic Narratives and Physiological Biomarkers for Prospective Stroke Risk Stratification
2609.25272.paper_summary: Prospective stroke risk stratification in primary care is challenging because early risk signals are distributed across routine biomarkers and unstructured clinical narratives. We propose MedGate-Fusion, a multi-modal gated architecture that integrates transformer-based embeddings of first-encounter narratives with ten routinely recorded risk markers. We used electronic medical record data from the Canadian Primary Care Sentinel Surveillance Network (CPCSSN). Starting from 808,921 encounter-level observations, we constructed a first-encounter cohort and retained 102,736 unique patient records with non-empty narratives and sufficient data to evaluate a five-year stroke outcome. To reduce explicit target leakage from diagnostic mentions in notes, we applied dictionary-based redaction of stroke-related terms prior to semantic encoding.
2609.25272.paper_summary_zh: 預測性中風風險分層在初級護理中具有挑戰性，因為早期風險信號分佈在常規生物標記和非結構化的臨床敘述中。<lb/>我們提出了MedGate-Fusion，一種多模態閘控架構，將基於Transformer的首次接觸敘述嵌入與十個常規記錄的風險標記整合在一起。<lb/>我們使用了來自加拿大初級護理哨兵監測網絡（CPCSSN）的電子病歷數據。<lb/>從808,921個接觸級觀察開始，我們構建了一個首次接觸的隊列，保留了102,736個具有非空敘述和足夠數據以評估五年中風結果的獨特患者記錄。<lb/>為了減少診斷提及中明確目標洩漏的情況，我們在語義編碼之前應用了基於字典的中風相關術語刪除。
